about: The producers and consumers of the shared-surface records (LB7A, GDI1, E26R, BC2A, S26R), and for every pair the rows of driver/contract/test/record-pair-test.cpp that cover it, the test that covers it elsewhere, or the reason why no caller reaches it. tools/quality/record_pairs.py checks this file against the tree and against the output of the test. A site is a function that writes a record magic; a producer with wire false makes a record that never leaves its process (a decoded copy, the opener's own record of a match).

producers.what: kernel driver standard allocations: primary, shadow, staging, GDI types 1..4
D3D11 shell runtime surface: LB7A v1 or v2 (NV12) with E26R v3, E26R v2 for the resource group, or E26R v4 for a GPU-only surface
D3D11 shell Present shadow: a device allocation that no other process opens
D3D11 shell ENGINE LAYOUT form: BC2A v2 SHARED with S26R
D3D12 shell linear surface: the primary, with E26R v1, v2, v3 (scan-out) or v4
D3D12 shell shared surface: LB7A v1 with E26R v3 through the contract writer (allocation-request.h prepare_shared_surface)
D3D12 shell ENGINE LAYOUT buffer: BC2A v2 SHARED with S26R
D3D12 shell raw allocation: BC2A v2, no resource record (every create outside the shareable envelope)
Vulkan winsys allocation (Mesa patch): BC2A, no resource record
application router: E26R v3 of the compositor's own surfaces
D3D11 open: the LB7A metadata of a decoded record
router: the normalised copy of a received E26R
D3D12 open of the ENGINE LAYOUT form: the opener's own S26R for the match

rows: P1 GDI type \d fmt \d+ -> D3D11 open
P1 GDI type 1 fmt \d+ -> D3D12 open

pairs.unreachable: the router reads the records of resources its own devices create or open; a kernel standard allocation reaches it only through C3 (lab lines BD-253)
the shadow is a device allocation of the shell; no runtime resource names it, so no process opens it
an S26R record is not a surface the compositor opens; the router passes it through
a D3D12 primary is opened by the compositor through the router (C5), not by a D3D11 OpenResource of an application

rows: S\d D3D12 shared create .* -> an opener
S\d D3D12 shared create .* -> an opener

pairs.unreachable: a raw allocation is not shared: no runtime resource with a shared handle names it, unless the create was shared, which the S rows cover

rows: P7 D3D12 raw BC2A v2, no record -> D3D11 open
P7 D3D12 raw BC2A v2, no record -> D3D12 open

pairs.unreachable: the winsys allocations of the hosted engines are device memory of one process; the shells export shared resources through their own records (P2, P3, P5, P6)
the router's own surfaces are the compositor's; no application opens them
